messages:
deploybot: :warning: Auto-hold on release slot 3899 — canary healthcheck breach (high error rate and malformed responses). Pinned to previous stable version v2026.1. Reason: runtime kv-cache mismatch observed on GPUs.

lee: Saw the spike in model output checksum mismatches ~30s before the hold. Error traces show bogus token sequences for repeated prefixes.

katy: This slot included the new int8 quantization kernel. Could be cache indexing bug. I'm rolling a debug dump on canary pods.

oncall_raj: I'm pulling logs and dumping KV cache metrics. If it's GPU kernel corruption we should avoid any rolling forward until we confirm.

ops_lead: Agreed. Immediate plan: 1) pin slot to v2026.1 (done), 2) rollback canary to 0% and stop traffic, 3) run supervised integrity checks on v2026.1 and the quantized variant. Do not unpin until we have a root cause. Ops to coordinate rollback.

ci_cd_bot: Actions executed: pin 3899 v2026.1; canary_scale 3899 0; scheduled re-eval window 1709999700 (10m).

katy: Debug dump attached to the release artifact storage (link). Key anomalies: repeated KV keys with null values during decode loop. Reproduced locally with the quantized runtime and sequence length 1024.

lee: Given reproduction, recommend rollback of the quantized kernel patch in the runtime repo and re-run microbench and integrity tests.

ops_lead: Do we have a safe reschedule window? We should aim for next maintenance window 2024-11-02 03:00-05:00Z and coordinate with infra for kernel patch rollout. If kernel revert is quick we can requeue earlier.

oncall_raj: For rollback steps: 1) confirm all canary pods at 0%, 2) drain any sticky sessions, 3) verify v2026.1 passes parity tests (content and latency), 4) unpin only after green. Oncall ready to execute.

katy: I'll open PR to revert kernel change and request expedited review. Tagging @ops_lead for deploy permission.

ci_cd_bot: Helpful commands:
```
/deploy status 3899
/deploy pin 3899 v2026.1
/deploy rollback 3899 --to v2026.1 --force
/deploy schedule 3899 --window "2024-11-02T03:00Z/2024-11-02T05:00Z"
```

lee: Also adding a short post-deploy parity harness for quantized builds to the CI matrix. That should catch this before rollout next time.

ops_lead: Good. Ops will block any automated canaries for quantized kernels until CI is extended. We'll draft release note: "Deployment paused and canary rolled back due to runtime KV-cache indexing error observed with new quantization kernel; rollback to stable version v2026.1 and revert kernel change pending further testing."

katy: Drafting PR and will add reproduction steps and test vectors.

oncall_raj: Running parity checks now — initial results show v2026.1 passes content integrity across sampled inputs.

ci_cd_bot: Next action scheduled: 1709999700 (2024-10-31T22:15Z) — re-eval after parity checks complete.

ops_lead: Once revert PR merged and CI passes, we'll schedule a controlled re-deploy to a small internal cohort, then expand to canary. If all green, plan reschedule to the maintenance window above and update release calendar and notes.

lee: Notifying platform kernel team and tagging the runtime-rt channel.

katy: ETA for PR review ~2 hours if reviewers are available. Will update thread with link.

ops_lead: Thanks — keep this pinned. We'll transition to the release thread for final scheduling and postmortem linking once resolved.
